verdict.rationale: An SoC platform's I/O specs are a fair axis, but the evidence pack never states PCIe generation or lane counts, storage interface support, or USB4/Thunderbolt/display connectivity for the X2 Elite Extreme. The vendor spec items cover only CPU cores and clocks, NPU TOPS and memory bandwidth, and the recorded spec-disclosure gap lists further omissions. The ASUS mini-PC item is a title only, with no I/O details.
